I don't know. I can't reliably recall the date or attendance of the first Syracuse–Colgate game, and attendance figures from the 1890s are often unrecorded or inconsistent across sources. Any specific number from me would be fabricated.

The Syracuse Orange football media guide's all-time results, Syracuse University Archives, or contemporary newspaper coverage (for example via the NY Historic Newspapers or Fultonhistory.com archives) are the places to check.
